2390-3966-8335.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-8335.description:
Gain life.
Neelix triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3968-4050-4078-5933.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-5933.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Popular Egotist triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

2440-3490-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact or creature.
2440-3490-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
2440-3490-6797.notes: If there is at least one other Servo on the battlefield to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

512-4091-4137.easyPrerequisites: Blossom-Clad Werewolf and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-4091-4137.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

1322-4316-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1849-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5531-5694-5913-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5531-5694-5913-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
5531-5694-5913-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Pinnacle Monk and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

5686-7084-7885.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

955-3259-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
955-3259-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

618-4456-6231-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Thunderclap Drake.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2533-3967-4681-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Chameleon.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3129-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-2034-3129-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1409-5184-5419.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve the Kalain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3534-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3534-4693.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
250-779-1479-3534-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1268-1355.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
1268-1355.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

483-1497-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1987-3980-4423-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

5263-6243-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

573-1825-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Gruul Turf and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
573-1825-6760.description:
Activate Gruul Turf and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Gruul Turf and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-3921-4120.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3693-3921-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3693-3921-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

1090-2292-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Restoration Angel.
1090-2292-6132.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

874-1492-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
874-1492-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

864-2639-3254-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
864-2639-3254-4871-5231.description:
Cast Nethroi for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Nethroi, adding {R}.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime, adding {R}{R}.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing an Ooze, adding {R}.
When the Ooze dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Ooze trigger, creating two 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

864-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Eternal Witness
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Eternal Witness
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

678-1965.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3668-4191-4209.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying {0} due to Aluren, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Mischievous Pup.
When Flesh Duplicate enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mischievous Pup from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mischievous Pup by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When Mischievous Pup enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Flesh Duplicate from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

536-1061-2506.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing and/or control at least eight permanents.
"Human", "Pirate", or "Wizard" chosen with Molten Echoes.
536-1061-2506.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing and control ten or more permanents, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Riptide Laboratory's second ability by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

277-1227-1240-4679.notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
277-1227-1240-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ordeal of Nylea, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Gatherer of Graces by sacrificing the Ordeal of Nylea token.
The Ordeal of Nylea token's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers twice, untapping them.
Resolve the Gatherer of Graces ability from step 2, regenerating it.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

698-2450-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
698-2450-5195.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {2}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {U} due to Will's ability, targeting any permanent.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2302-4215-4825-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Emrakul.
Emrakul and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Emrakul trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Emrakul, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Emrakul's power.
Repeat.

9-411-2500-2604-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Mirage Mirror twice by paying {4}, targeting Grinning Ignus and Gilded Lotus.
Resolve the first Mirage Mirror ability, causing it to become a copy of Gilded Lotus until end of turn.
Activate Mirage Mirror by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the second Mirage Mirror ability, causing it to become a copy of Grinning Ignus until end of turn.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Mirage Mirror by paying {1}.
Repeat from step 2 until you have a very large storm count.
Cast Grapeshot by paying {1}{R}.
Grapeshot's storm ability triggers, creating a copy of Grapeshot for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve all Grapeshots, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).
